direct_human_evidence.root_verification: Read the actual human messages through read_thread; not inferred from a peer recommendation.

decision: Prioritize a RoboCasa setup with an actually released pi0.5 policy, checking the LeRobot route first. Hold unlaunched fresh RoboTwin SFT, its new qualification/allocation work, the earlier RoboTwin native-baseline restoration launch, and LIBERO search. Preserve all partial code and evidence.
scope: Verify an exact released pi0.5 checkpoint and its supported RoboCasa/RoboCasa365 version, observations/action mapping, normalization and task coverage. Reuse official supported environment/policy code; then provide a concrete finite setup/qualification and matched PPO profile. No new model/simulator/trainer framework.
policy_limit: Do not claim a RoboCasa pi0.5 release exists until verified. Do not silently substitute released pi0, Motus, LIBERO weights or fresh SFT. LeRobot availability does not by itself establish native RLinf PPO checkpoint/likelihood compatibility.
allocation_status: No new RoboCasa source pin, model binding, CPU/GPU/action reservation or allocation yet. Existing Flora archived-fixture repair remains independent and may complete under its original admitted clock. No old budget transfer.
standing_execution: Sole finish_assembly handles resources, actual probes, capacity/write admission and recovery. Once exact compatible environment/checkpoint/code and finite validation/resource profile are reviewed and ready, execute within the human-approved per-job<=8GPUs/<8h scope without a repeated readiness ACK.
implementation_direction: Keep RLinf PPO as the training framework where the official RoboCasa/RoboCasa365 adapter and checkpoint ABI match; LeRobot may supply a released pi0.5 checkpoint. LeRobot inquiry is not a silent trainer replacement.
released_policy_status: Protocol owner confirmed an official RoboCasa365 pi0.5 leaderboard release; exact pinned checkpoint/processor/version/native loading binding still pending. RLinf documented pi0 checkpoint is not a pi0.5 substitute.
benchmark: RoboCasa365, explicitly selected by human; not legacy RoboCasa
supplied_candidate: AaronHuangWei/pi05-robocasa365-composite-seen-sft-100k: primary candidate to verify including actual revision/source/normalization/coverage, not yet adopted as loaded.
